title: Shared lists
description: Every list of values that more than one project writes or reads, defined once. Each item has a code (what records carry, never changed), a name (what people see) and what it covers. Adding an item is one change here.

location.title: Location from the shared list
location.description: Where a story matters: the whole world, all of India, or one Indian city.

global.title: Global
global.description: News for every reader, wherever they are.

oneOf.title: Global
oneOf.description: News that matters around the world, not just in India: world affairs, global markets, international sport. Every reader sees it.

national.title: National
national.description: News for readers anywhere in India.

oneOf.title: India
oneOf.description: News that matters across India: national politics, the economy, national teams, and anything that affects people in every city.

local.title: Local
local.description: News for readers in one Indian city. More cities come after version one.

oneOf.title: Mumbai
oneOf.description: Mumbai and its metropolitan region, including Thane and Navi Mumbai.

oneOf.title: Delhi NCR
oneOf.description: Delhi and the National Capital Region, including Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad and Faridabad.

oneOf.title: Bengaluru
oneOf.description: Bengaluru and its surrounding urban district.

category.title: Category from the shared list
category.description: What a story or a post is about.

oneOf.title: Crypto
oneOf.description: Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies: prices, exchanges, regulation and new projects.

oneOf.title: Finance
oneOf.description: Money and markets: shares, the rupee, interest rates, banks, taxes and personal finance.

oneOf.title: Business
oneOf.description: Companies and the economy: results, deals, start-ups, jobs and whole industries.

oneOf.title: AI
oneOf.description: Artificial intelligence: new models, the companies building them, how people use them, and the rules around them.

oneOf.title: Sports
oneOf.description: Cricket, football and every other sport: matches, players, teams and tournaments.

oneOf.title: Politics
oneOf.description: Government and elections: Parliament, state governments, policies and political parties.

oneOf.title: Entertainment
oneOf.description: Films, streaming, music and celebrities, from Bollywood and regional cinema to global stars.

oneOf.title: General
oneOf.description: News that fits no other category: weather, transport, civic issues, crime, education and health.

route.title: Route from the shared list
route.description: How a feed item reached the product, which decides how Product credits it.

oneOf.title: Found
oneOf.description: A creator's post that our bots found on X, shown in a story's feed as the original post: embedded from X and credited to its creator, never copied.

oneOf.title: Made
oneOf.description: Our own content, made by News Desk from the sourced pool and credited to Hrizzup, together with the creators of any found posts it builds on.

oneOf.title: Posted
oneOf.description: Posted directly in the app by a creator or a user, and credited to the account that posted it.
